story.hu: Széphalom kis hely Sátoraljaújhely mellett. Itt él Kazinczy Ferenc.
story.en: Széphalom is a small place near Sátoraljaújhely. Ferenc Kazinczy lives here.
story.ro: Széphalom este un loc mic lângă Sátoraljaújhely. Aici trăiește Ferenc Kazinczy.

story.hu: Kazinczy író, és nagyon szereti a magyar nyelvet.
story.en: Kazinczy is a writer, and he loves the Hungarian language.
story.ro: Kazinczy este scriitor și iubește foarte mult limba maghiară.

story.hu: Az 1800-as években sok dologra nincs magyar szó. Az emberek német vagy latin szavakat használnak.
story.en: In the 1800s there's no Hungarian word for many things. People use German or Latin words.
story.ro: În anii 1800 multe lucruri nu au un cuvânt maghiar. Oamenii folosesc cuvinte germane sau latinești.

story.hu: Kazinczy és barátai új szavakat csinálnak régi magyar szavakból.
story.en: Kazinczy and his friends make new words from old Hungarian words.
story.ro: Kazinczy și prietenii lui fac cuvinte noi din cuvinte maghiare vechi.

story.hu: Például a „fagy” szóból lesz a fagylalt (ice cream), a „zeng” szóból a zongora.
story.en: For example, from fagy (frost) comes fagylalt (ice cream), and from zeng (to resound) comes zongora (piano).
story.ro: De exemplu, din fagy (ger) vine fagylalt (înghețată), iar din zeng (a răsuna) vine zongora (pian).

facts.hu: Széphalmon van a Magyar Nyelv Múzeuma.
facts.en: Széphalom is home to the Museum of the Hungarian Language.
facts.ro: La Széphalom se află Muzeul Limbii Maghiare.

facts.hu: A nyelvújítás több ezer új szót hozott.
facts.en: The language reform created thousands of new words, many still used every day.
facts.ro: Reforma limbii a creat mii de cuvinte noi, multe folosite și azi zilnic.

facts.en: 13 November is the Day of the Hungarian Language.

questions.qEn: Which word does fagylalt come from?
